IsAllowedInShops.rationale: Matches LuckyFysh.cs:15. The flag is consumed by the sim's shop stock filter (run.py:626 filters on `cls.rarity == RelicRarity.SHOP and cls.is_allowed_in_shops`) and by pull_relic_from_front's shop_legal overload (run.py:559-574), so unlike most declarative flags this one is live.

IsAllowed.maps_to: is_allowed (sts2_rl/relics/lucky_fysh.py:22) -> is_before_act3_treasure_chest (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:82-84), consulted by RunState._drop_disallowed_from_grab_bag (sts2_rl/run.py:769) before every pool pull
IsAllowed.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: pool eligibility is modelled now. `Relic.is_allowed(run)` exists on the sim's base (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:198, default True) and this relic overrides it with `is_before_act3_treasure_chest(run)` (sts2_rl/relics/lucky_fysh.py:22), the `TotalFloor < 41` predicate of RelicModel.IsBeforeAct3TreasureChest (RelicModel.cs:452-456). RunState._drop_disallowed_from_grab_bag (sts2_rl/run.py:769) applies it before EVERY pull and REMOVES the rejects from the bag -- pull_relic_from_front (run.py:731), pull_relic_from_back (run.py:752) and the Shop-rarity bag (run.py:783) are the only three pull paths -- mirroring RelicGrabBag.RemoveDisallowedRelicsFromDeques (RelicGrabBag.cs:218-270), and `Relic.is_allowed_at_neow` now DELEGATES to is_allowed (sts2_rl/relics/base.py:211-222 = RelicModel.cs:443-446) so the Neow pools (sts2_rl/events/neow.py:72) cannot read a stale flag. Verified by execution against today's code: every one of the 17 cluster members returns is_allowed False at total_floor 60 and True at floor 0. WAS: the sim's Relic base declared no is_allowed member at all and populate_relic_grab_bags shuffled the pool once at run init with no per-pull filter, so the relic stayed pullable for the whole run and a late pull also shifted every subsequent pull.

guards.what: G3 (LIVE): even a correct after_card_added_to_deck port would miss the DECK-TRANSFORM route into the deck
guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-27: the deck-TRANSFORM route fires both deck-add hooks. RunState.transform_card now runs `modify_card_being_added_to_deck` over every relic before the insert and `after_card_added_to_deck` after it (sts2_rl/run.py:567-570 and :582-583), with the C# citation in the comment -- CardCmd.Transform on a Deck pile fires Hook.ModifyCardBeingAddedToDeck (CardCmd.cs:427-434) and Hook.AfterCardChangedPiles (CardCmd.cs:447). WAS: transform_card deleted the original and appended the replacement straight onto self.deck, bypassing run.add_card, so Lucky Fysh granted no gold and the egg relics did not upgrade a transformed-in card.

guards.what: N1: `card.Pile != null && pile.Type == PileType.Deck && card.Owner == base.Owner` (LuckyFysh.cs:26-27) vs the sim's hook, which is already narrowed to 'a card was appended to the run deck'
guards.rationale: The owner clause is single-player-structural. The pile clause is the substantive one and the sim's slicing is correct rather than lucky: PileType.Deck is the run's master deck, never a combat pile, so the four C# dispatch sites that matter are the deck ones (CardPileCmd.cs:635 for an Add, CardCmd.cs:447 for a transform); combat pile changes (CardPileCmd.cs:683) can never have `pile.Type == Deck` and so cannot trigger the relic. The transform site is guard G3's subject, not this entry's. The one clause the sim's hook NAME loses is that C# fires on any pile CHANGE into the deck rather than only on an add -- with the transform site accounted for separately, no ported path moves an existing card into the deck pile.

guards.what: N2: `GoldVar(15)` (LuckyFysh.cs:17) has no constant in the port to check against
guards.rationale: Recorded as a deliberate NON-finding: PROMPT.md bug class 19 is a port that pins the WRONG constant behind a citation-shaped docstring, and the check here is that the port pins no constant at all, so there is nothing mis-stated. 15 is the pinned non-ascension value (no AscensionHelper call anywhere in LuckyFysh.cs) and is the number a fix must use.
